basis: The October 30, 2025 earnings release is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. FET reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $196,231,000 for Q3 2025 and $207,806,000 for Q3 2024 in the same table. Revenue fell 5.57% year over year, below the $197,415,700 cutoff. The August forecast extended to $200 million. The earliest date remains unverified because I could verify only portions of a September investor presentation.

coverage.detail: May 1 Q1 release. Management guided Q2 adjusted EBITDA to $18–22 million and maintained full-year free cash flow guidance of $40–60 million. Neither figure bounds Q3 revenue.
May 2 Q1 call. Management said revenue could decline starting in Q3 if commodity prices failed to rebound. It gave no magnitude for that possible Q3 decline.

FET announced the CEO’s June 11 Sidoti presentation. In the public remarks, he repeated the conditional Q3 decline scenario from May. [June 11 transcript](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-sidotis-conference-strategic-insights-and-growth-93CH-4091481)
August 7 Q2 release. FET guided Q3 adjusted EBITDA to $19–23 million and raised annual free cash flow guidance to $60–80 million. The release supplied no Q3 revenue ceiling.
August 8 Q2 call. CFO Lyle Williams forecast Q3 revenue of $180–200 million. The high end exceeded the cutoff by $2,584,300. His separate $760–800 million revenue forecast covered the full year.

September 18 Water Tower fireside chat. The CFO’s roughly 5% decline compared Q3 industry activity with Q1 activity. He discussed annual EBITDA of about $85 million and gave no tighter Q3 consolidated revenue range. [Public remarks](https://ng.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-water-tower-chat-strategic-growth-and-cash-flow-focus-93CH-2110286)
September 19 Form 8-K. Item 5.02 reported director Leslie Beyer’s retirement and contained no revenue update.

The PLS archive lists a 29-slide September 2025 investor presentation under September 29. Indexed slides show $393 million of first-half consolidated revenue and $233 million of first-half Drilling and Completions revenue. I could not verify the complete deck or its original issuer publication date, so a tighter Q3 forecast elsewhere in it remains unresolved.
October 6 notice. FET scheduled its October 31 call and said it would issue results before the call. The notice contained no preliminary sales figure.

October 30 actuals. The revenue row in the condensed consolidated statements of income gives 196,231 and 207,806, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024. The headline’s 2% decline uses the sequential comparison.

publication_date_evidence: FET’s investor-relations release displays October 30, 2025 and carries the same Houston dateline. Its October 31 Form 8-K confirms that FET issued the release on October 30. This verifies the actual-results publication date. [Form 8-K, Item 2.02](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1401257/000140125725000106/fet-20251030.htm)
